prompt: The first-person perspective begins with a steady ascent up a snow-covered slope on the Mardi Himal Trail in Kaski, Nepal. The camera moves forward, capturing the texture of the powdery snow underfoot as it pans slightly to reveal a rugged, rocky terrain interspersed with patches of snow. The surrounding landscape is vast and open, with distant mountain peaks shrouded in mist, creating a serene and isolated atmosphere. As the camera continues its upward journey, it tilts upwards to show a clear blue sky above, contrasting sharply with the white snow and dark rocks. The movement is smooth and deliberate, allowing viewers to take in the intricate details of the natural environment, from the jagged edges of the rocks to the sparse vegetation clinging to the slopes. The lighting is bright and natural, highlighting the crispness of the snowy surface and casting long shadows that accentuate the contours of the terrain. The scene remains empty of people, emphasizing the solitude and untouched beauty of this high-altitude trail. The camera occasionally shifts focus between the snowy path and the rocky outcrops, providing a comprehensive view of the challenging yet breathtaking landscape.
